purpose: Teach: 神浦/杉村/野坂/荒井/北野/日高/牛尾/広瀬

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新任の神浦部長を歓迎しろ
lines.en: I want you to welcome our new department head, Kamiura.
lines.style: Crisp, commanding tone. Measured cadence. No room for negotiation. The voice of someone accustomed to being heard and obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業の杉村課長の出張日程を整えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll arrange the travel schedule for Sugimura, our sales manager.
lines.style: Efficient, businesslike. No hesitation. Kenji is already translating the directive into action—rapid-fire mental organization. Brisk delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、技術担当の野坂主任にプロジェクトを任せろ
lines.en: Assign the project to Nozaka, our technical lead.
lines.style: Direct command. Slightly sharper than the opening—no buffer. Hiroshi is moving through his list with purpose. Clipped phrasing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広報の荒井様の戦略を採用します
lines.en: Understood. I'll adopt Arai's strategy from the PR department.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment. Kenji's voice is steady and responsive—he's keeping pace with Hiroshi's rhythm. Confirming each task before moving to the next.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、顧問の北野様にご助言を仰げ
lines.en: Get advice from Kitano, our corporate advisor.
lines.style: Same command register as before. Hiroshi is in full directive mode—efficient, unbothered by the frequency of instructions. Minimal inflection.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経理の日高様の決算スケジュールを整えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll coordinate the closing schedule with Hidaka from accounting.
lines.style: Echo of Kenji's earlier pacing. He's absorbed the pattern now—absorbing directives and converting them to action items without thinking. Smooth handoff.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、人事の牛尾様に新人研修を任せろ
lines.en: Put the new-hire training program in Ushio's hands from HR.
lines.style: Penultimate instruction. Hiroshi's delivery is still sharp but there's a slight breath—he's nearing the end of his list. Same authority, same economy of language.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。法務の広瀬様に契約書確認を依頼します
lines.en: Understood. I'll have Hirose from legal review the contracts.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Kenji's delivery closes with a sense of completion—all items logged, all next steps clear. Solid, settled tone. The interview is over.
